notes: Names printed without a suffix (FLORA, VICTOR, GUY, CHICKASAW, WARNER, and the 250 overlap labels CASSATT, VOLKERT, ADA) are written with 'Street'. Flora is printed 'FLORA (NOT OPEN)' here; its lines are drawn and it is the same 50' street as on 250. The left strip (x < ~1160) is the sheet 250 overlap, drawn in outline: Cassatt, Volkert and Ada (the 40' piece east of Ravine, written 'Ada Street (east of Ravine)' as on 250) end at Flora (T, repeated as ties). W. McMillan (60', north line y~233 in the west to ~200 at the right, south line y~594 to ~562) runs across the top; the blocks north of it (sheets 258/259) are continuous over Flora, Victor and Chickasaw, so those are T. Guy jogs at McMillan: south of it Guy's lines are x~3895/4213, north of it the opening between the 258 and 259 blocks is x~4218/4518 (also 50'), one full street width further east; two T points, the north piece written 'Guy Street (north of McMillan)'. Flora, Victor, Guy and Chickasaw all cross Warner (60', lines y~7140-7200 / 7504-7570) and continue south onto 239/240; Guy's south-east corner is hidden by the scale bar, but its west line and water pipe continue south. A 10' alley (printed 10') runs east from a dead end at x~4735 across Chickasaw at y~1272 (recorded as alley segments). The drawn area stops at x~6000; the strip beyond is the 252 overlap.
